standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Who indeed? I am a wise Knight of the Owl. I serve the Justiciar of the Owl.

options.text: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?

steps.player: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?

steps.text: If the player has not completed Mage Arena II:

steps.npc: Saradomin's wisest of servants. It surprises me that you've not heard of his many feats.
Of course. Do you see the foliage around you, adventurer?
For it to be in such a state means that there is unimaginable evil nearby. These plants were grown personally by Zachariah, the Justiciar of the Owl.
Anything he plants blossoms with unimaginable vigour. You may have noticed that he has a love for lilies. Perhaps he knew they'd serve multiple purposes in a place like this.

steps.player: Hmm. Hopefully I'll meet him one day.

steps.npc: If you do, send my regards.
I'm but a loyal watcher, that is all.

steps.text: If the player has completed Mage Arena II:

steps.player: Your helmet looks familiar. I defeated a knight who wore one with a similar design.

steps.npc: This helmet? It is based on the one worn by the Justiciar of the Owl. You mean to say you fought the great Zachariah and lived to tell the tale?
This can't be... You killed the great Zachariah?

steps.player: Hmm, he didn't really die. He just sort of faded away and left behind a glowing magical hand.

steps.npc: Strange, when I saw him last he had no magical hand to speak of... I suppose time has changed the world above beyond my recollection...
They are a symbol of the wise. You see, owls can see the light in the darkest of places. Their presence within the sepulchre is one of grave importance.

steps.player: Yes, I saw some down there. They seemed incorporeal in some way, as if they were ghosts...

steps.npc: Indeed. These creatures have the blessing of Saradomin and the wisdom of ages long past. They are the watchers of the Hallowed Sepulchre. The last defence against unseen evils.
Thank you for freeing me, adventurer. If the owls have already retreated that far back, it's best that I reside here. From this position I can more effectively watch for evil.

steps.player: Hmm... Perhaps I should steal from graves more often?

upon-opening-a-coffin-in-the-hallowed-se.npc: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
